cvTips.title: Action, what, result.
cvTips.text: Start with a verb (Built, Automated, Migrated, Designed), name the EBS object or API, end with the business result.

cvTips.title: Numbers win.
cvTips.text: Records loaded, programs built, hours saved, users supported.

cvTips.title: Name the real technology.
cvTips.text: FND_FLEX_VALUE_RULES_PKG, GL_INTERFACE, BI Publisher RTF. Recruiters and ATS filters search for these exact terms.

cvTips.title: Module and release.
cvTips.text: "Oracle EBS R12.2 GL" says much more than "Oracle".

cvTips.title: Show the full cycle.
cvTips.text: MD050, MD070, build, UAT, MD120 deployment.

cvTips.title: Keep it confidential.
cvTips.text: No client names, ticket IDs, internal custom object names or sensitive volumes. Stranote flags these in amber.

cvTips.title: Keep it fresh.
cvTips.text: Check this page every month and export a new version.

commonQuestions: Target PROD date and any freeze window?
